governance: Takes effect when a maintainer merges this record into main. Immutable; any change of registry, classification, population, series, codes or record semantics needs a new G1 contract with a new freeze record. Adoption does not activate v2: implementation, genesis, rulesets and natural runs follow contract-v2 section 16 and a separate maintainer decision.
limitations: Expected records were derived from the contract by its author; independence comes from the separate implementation required by activation criterion 3.
Registry corruption is unrecoverable inside v2; recovery needs a new G1 contract and genesis.

Level-1 witness leaves an undetected tail-truncation window before the next retained binding; against non-admins it is closed by the registry ruleset, against a malicious admin only by an external checkpoint.
G1 v2 is defined for phase pilot only; reveal entries are registered and disclosed but not evaluated.
scope: G1/provenance layer only: definition of scientific attempt, registry authority, bind-before-measure, PRE/BUNDLE/MISSING, G1 population, series and transitions, production/test API, ruleset/write-token/witness requirements, activation criteria. The measurement layer is delsk.oracle-contract.v1 by hash.
